❓ Zakat — Quick Guide
📅 When is it due?
Zakat becomes due when your wealth has been above the Nisab threshold for a full Islamic lunar year (Hawl). Many Muslims pay in Ramadan for blessings.
💰 What rate?
The standard Zakat rate is 2.5% of total eligible (Zakatable) wealth above the Nisab threshold.
🏠 What's excluded?
Personal home, car used for daily transport, household furniture, clothing, and business equipment are generally exempt from Zakat.
🥈 Silver vs Gold Nisab?
Most scholars recommend using the lower Silver Nisab as it benefits more recipients. Some prefer gold. Use what your scholar advises.
